verdict.rationale: This story describes an in-browser feedback/feature-flag/performance widget for end-user-facing sites (a product like Highlight.io or a feature-flag toolbar), which is a different product category than Railway's infrastructure/deployment platform. Railway provides deployment, scaling, logs, and dashboards, but nothing in its evidence relates to an embeddable in-app toolbar for feedback or feature flags on a live site — this axis is a category error for a cloud deployment platform.
